svg.title: PulseFit | Physical Relational Schema
svg.desc: Relation signatures, complete attributes and SQL constraints · Separate from the ER model · Migrations 001–003
svg.text: Relation signatures, complete attributes and SQL constraints · Separate from the ER model · Migrations 001–003
CK: id; email. PK: id. UNIQUE(id, role) is a nonminimal reference superkey.
CHECK: name length 2–100; email = lower(btrim(email)) and contains @.
CHECK: password_hash length >= 60; role IN (MEMBER, TRAINER).
CHECK: role = TRAINER; bio length <= 2000; experience_years 0–80.
CHECK: location length <= 120. specialties is a PostgreSQL text[] array.
CK: id; name. PK: id. No FK to workout snapshots or trainer profiles.
FK trainer_id -> trainer_profiles(user_id). UNIQUE(id, trainer_id): nonminimal superkey.
CHECK: status IN (OPEN, CLOSED); 0 < duration <= 4 hours.
EXCLUDE GiST: trainer_id WITH =, tstzrange(starts_at, ends_at, [)) WITH &&.
Trigger: new start in next 90 days; trainer/time immutable; no occupied closure.
PARTIAL UNIQUE: slot_id WHERE status = CONFIRMED; history may contain many rows.
Triggers guard booking identity/time/state and append booking_audit.
FK booking_id -> bookings(id). old_status is nullable for initial insert.
Trigger appends changes; FK itself permits zero audit rows per booking.
All FKs: NOT NULL components; MATCH SIMPLE; NO ACTION; not deferrable.
No standalone bookings.trainer_id FK; the slot/trainer pair enforces it.
KEY LEGEND: PK chosen primary key · FK component of a reference · UK unique column · CK candidate key (minimal) · NN NOT NULL
Nonminimal UNIQUE(id, role) and UNIQUE(id, trainer_id) are supporting reference superkeys, not additional candidate keys.
Physical indexes: PK/UNIQUE B-trees; GiST non-overlap; partial booking uniqueness; member/date, trainer/status and trainer/date B-trees.
Vector columns are nullable, stored in PostgreSQL via pgvector; current searches use exact cosine distance, with no HNSW/IVFFlat index.
RLS: member_profiles, trainer_profiles, trainer_availability, bookings, booking_audit (12 policies). Runtime grants are configured separately.
Infrastructure only: schema_migrations(name text PK, checksum text NN, applied_at timestamptz NN DEFAULT now()).
See RELATIONAL_SCHEMA.md for full SQL predicates, index catalog, normalization exceptions, trigger behavior and authorization limits.
